# The Intel library sources Casimir's number layer links (CAS 011, D3), relative to the library's LIBRARY/ directory:
# the objects of Intel's libbid.a that a link of src/casim.c and third_party/abn/abn_intel.c pulls in, read from the
# linker's map (scripts/intel-sources.sh rewrites this file). CMake, the ESP-IDF component and the wasm build compile
# exactly these; the Makefile builds the whole library with Intel's makefile, and the golden test shows the two agree.
